messages:
tessa_support: Escalating to CS — trial account for Veridian Health stuck at ingestion step. Getting TokenizationError on bulk ingest, customer blocked on activation.

maya_cs: thx for the ping. can you paste the shortest reproducible error and whether support thinks it's on our side or theirs? we need to message the customer within 30m. @jordan_pm fyi on potential demo impact.

tessa_support: Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T11:22:10Z ERROR ingest: TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence at offset 2048
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "ingest/worker.py", line 145, in process
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text)
TokenizationError: invalid byte sequence
```
Support suspecting malformed payload (null bytes / wrong charset). Estimate 1-3 hours to triage.

maya_cs: Comms plan: 1) immediate ack w/ 2-hour investigation ETA; 2) offer 30m troubleshooting call + quick sanitize script; 3) offer CSV fallback (we process) so trial can continue. agree?

jordan_pm: agree. i'll prepare a 1-page checklist + small validation script they can run pre-ingest. recommend we add this to trial onboarding email after.

liam_se: quick tech note: common causes are stray 0x00 bytes or non-utf8 blobs. i'll attach a tiny sanitize tool and a repro. if they can't run it, we can accept a CSV and clean server-side.

tessa_support: sending ack to customer now: "Thanks — we see an ingestion tokenizer error; investigating and will update within 2 hours. We can do a short triage call or accept a CSV export for us to ingest if you prefer."

escalation_bot: Runbook entry created (priority: trial-impact): https://console.redwood/escalations/1767345123

jordan_pm: validation snippet (to send):
```
# validate_payload.py
import sys
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    b=open(f,'rb').read()
    if b.find(b'\x00')!=-1:
        print('FOUND_NULL_BYTE',f)
    try:
        b.decode('utf-8')
    except Exception:
        print('BAD_ENCODING',f)
        raise
    print('OK',f)
```

liam_se: we did a quick triage call with the customer — found a null byte in one file. ran sanitize locally, sample ingested successfully. pushing script and repro to ticket and to shared enablement repo.

maya_cs: customer accepted the live assist and trial is unblocked. follow-ups: jordan_pm to add checklist to onboarding materials, liam_se to PR sanitize tool into repo, tessa_support to close ticket with detailed notes and notify billing. closing escalation, marking as resolved. :thumbsup:
